issues.description: Method addGuestStudents(int): the UML in the problem statement declares addGuestStudents(int) with return type void, but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. The template leaves the method as a TODO (no signature), creating ambiguity for students about which signature to implement. This mismatch can cause confusion and may lead to failing tests or compilation errors if students follow one artifact while automated tests or the reference use the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's addGuestStudents(int) to return void and perform the addition without returning a boolean to match the UML/problem statement, or (B) update the problem statement and UML to declare addGuestStudents(int): boolean (and explain the boolean meaning, e.g., success/failure), and add that boolean-returning signature to the template Lecture.java so students have the correct method signature to implement.
